description: Test functions for documentation internationalization provider and model configuration, verifying environment variable overrides and defaults.

methods.name: TestDocsPiProviderPrefersExplicitOverride
methods.description: Tests that the docs Pi provider prefers explicit environment variable override when set.

methods.name: TestDocsPiProviderPrefersOpenAIEnvWhenAvailable
methods.description: Tests that the docs Pi provider falls back to the OpenAI API key environment variable when explicit provider is not set.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelUsesProviderDefault
methods.description: Ensures that the docs Pi model uses the default value associated with the provider if no explicit model is set.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelKeepsOpenAIDefaultAtGPT54
methods.description: Checks that the OpenAI default model is used when provider is openai and no explicit model is provided.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelPrefersExplicitOverride
methods.description: Verifies that an explicit model override takes precedence over default environment settings.
